W05.title: Run durable isolated file operations
row: Run durable isolated file operations
apps/worker/src/; packages/files/src/; packages/operations/src/; apps/server/src/operations/

Implement queued operations with durable ids, ownership, bounded retries, cancellation, input limits and artifact expiry. Keep Chromium and parsing outside the API process. Reject external file paths and private-network URLs, revalidate redirects, sanitize SVG, and make repeated job delivery converge to one result. Use the authenticated P01 principal for job submission, polling, cancellation and artifact retrieval. Add the operation adapter to the existing server bootstrap and reject cross-owner jobs on every path. Do not introduce a fixture authentication bypass. Deny renderer network egress, resolving authorized images and fonts into bounded local inputs before render. Enforce per-job CPU, memory and wall-clock limits in a killable process/container. Give each owner/job an isolated temporary directory and reclaim it on cancel, timeout or crash recovery. Parse embedded/uploaded fonts in the same isolation and reject hostile fonts. A killed job must not affect the next owner job.
